trust_center.repositoryDescription: Controlled repository for GHEC-US FedRAMP certification and assessment information.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Public GHEC-US FedRAMP information is available without an account in the FedRAMP Rev5 Class C (Moderate) section of the FAQ at https://ghec.github.trust.page/faq. Federal agencies request the controlled certification package by selecting "GHEC-US FedRAMP certification package (federal agencies)" in the FedRAMP Rev5 Class C (Moderate) category under Resources at https://ghec.github.trust.page/resources?s=c6kcmwi0s3o4sli7lp3b6&name=ghec-us-fed-ramp-certification-package-%28federal-agencies%29 and requesting access from an agency email address. GitHub then shares the package through an approved channel.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure configuration and customer-responsibility guidance for operating GHEC-US in its assessed configuration.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Source code hosting, branches, commits, Git over HTTPS/SSH
PR workflow, reviews, merge controls, rulesets/branch protections
Outbound event notifications to customer endpoints
Customer-operated runner agents. In scope when: Customer-operated compute is customer responsibility
AI coding assistance: code completion, chat, agent mode, code review, PR summaries, CLI. In scope when: Enterprise policy "Restrict Copilot to FedRAMP models" must be enabled
Identity lifecycle via customer IdP (SAML/OIDC + SCIM). In scope when: Customer IdP is customer responsibility
Enterprise audit events; streaming to customer SIEM/storage. In scope when: Streaming destination is customer responsibility

current.service_desc: GitHub Enterprise Cloud with Data Residency (GHEC-US) is a commercial, multitenant SaaS offering for software development and repository management. It enables organizations to host and version source code, collaborate through pull requests and issues, automate software delivery workflows, enforce enterprise access and governance policies, and use integrated software security capabilities. GHEC-US provides tenant domain isolation and data residency for customer code and repository data in the United States. Certain services and configurations are subject to the Minimum Assessment Scope conditions in the public service inventory.
